# Brief

## What this app is

A personal reading list: books I am reading, have read, and want to read.

## Who uses it

One person, on their phone, adding a book when they hear of it and ticking it off when done.

## Deliberately out of scope

- sharing lists with other people

_Agreed in the initial scoping conversation; the full record, including what was considered and rejected, is in `docs/decisions/000-initial-scope.md`._
